entities.summary: Guy Antony Chambers is an English songwriter, musician and record producer. He has collaborated with Robbie Williams, Tina Turner, Kylie Minogue, Will Young, Scissor Sisters, Busted, Melanie C, Diana Ross, Tom Jones, James Blunt, Marlon Roudette, Rufus Wainwright, and Mark Ronson.
